scope: Original Level::UpdateListener listener selection/data and source-setting defaults. No production caller or gameplay enrollment is asserted.

listener.constructor_source: Level::Level @ 0x3f3128 and C2 duplicate @ 0x3f34c0 set word 57 to 1; no other assignment to this Level member was found in recovered pseudocode

source_rules.anchor_2: position is local player's target position when that target exists; otherwise the zero-initialized position remains
source_rules.orientation_2: front is actual camera look-at vector with z forced to 0
source_rules.up_vector_0: up is actual camera up vector
source_rules.camera_gate: SetListenerPos is skipped when Level+0x128 camera is absent, even for player-target position
source_rules.coordinate_scaling: the selected source vectors are passed unchanged; no visual-to-audio 0.01 conversion

minimal_randoms.meaning: false leaves normal Random::GetRandom combat-sound list selection enabled; true exits before those source combat-sound branches
minimal_randoms.override: DebugSwitches.savegame may override the map value if the actual source filesystem provides it
minimal_randoms.production_requirement: Use the current actual DebugSwitches value when available; false is only the source default when no persisted override exists
minimal_randoms.shipped_override_evidence: No DebugSwitches.savegame is present in the checked original asset trees; a separately scoped discovery fixture is not runtime authority

native_initial_state.constructor_behavior: zeroes decoder 16-bit fields at offsets +8, +10, +16, and +18
native_initial_state.runtime_mapping: fresh_native_state_v68 verifies the selected actual native VXN has a state and that its first state points to a valid playlist, then returns index 0
native_initial_state.caveat: This records decoder initialization and index mapping, not an authored-state semantic name for any specific VXN
